einzeiler: Calley Means targets Trump advisers, Senate Democrats challenge Schumer, and a pilot's…
kurzfassung: Former MAHA adviser Calley Means claims President Trump's close aides undermined key health initiatives to protect corporate donors. Meanwhile, Senate Democrats face an internal revolt over Chuck Schumer's leadership as they prepare to take control of Congress. In aviation news, the grieving father of a young co-pilot killed in a Florida plane crash defends her qualifications and professionalism.
stichpunkte: Calley Means alleges White House advisers blocked MAHA policies like defining ultra-processed foods to shield industry donors.
White House officials and lobbyists strongly deny Means's allegations regarding corporate influence on vapes and glyphosate.
House and Senate Democrats prepare aggressive congressional investigations into the Trump administration starting in January.
Attorney General Todd Blanch defends Department of Justice lawyers representing administration officials against congressional oversight.
Senator Bernie Sanders urges Democrats not to let investigations overshadow urgent working-class issues like childhood poverty.
Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer faces growing resistance from newly elected senators seeking generational leadership changes.
Senator-elect Adam Hamilton and Senator Alyssa Slotkin question Schumer's ability to unite the party effectively.
The father of the late co-pilot Natalia defends her flight credentials and composure during the fatal Florida plane crash.

clips.hook: Chuck Schumer viewed as a divisive political figure in conservative regions.
clips.text: A newly elected senator explains his opposition to the current leader by pointing out that the incumbent carries significant political polarization among voters in Kansas.

clips.hook: A young aviator found profound joy in getting paid for her passion.
clips.text: The father shares a personal memory of his daughter expressing sheer disbelief and happiness that she could earn a living doing what she loved most.

beschreibung:
Former MAHA adviser Calley Means goes public over the ways he says some of President Trump's closest advisers are undermining the president's health agenda to protect corporate interests and political donors. Democrats prepare sweeping investigations into the Trump administration as they prepare to take control of Congress, while party leaders face pressure to pursue impeachment proceedings. Senate Democrat Leader Chuck Schumer faces growing opposition from newly-elected senators who are calling for new leadership despite his confidence that he will reclaim the majority leader's position. The father of the 20-year-old co-pilot killed in a deadly Florida Learjet crash defends his daughter's qualifications and praises her courage during the aircraft's final moments.
